name: OD Fit Pipeline
description: Executable pipeline (App 2, A2.3): on a timer, reads stored operator-ephemeris OEM records (storage_query), fits SGP4 SupGP/OMM mean elements per object with the existing OD fit (od::fit_sgp4_series), and ingests (storage_ingest_with_source) + signs + publishes schema-exact fitted OMM records with SourceTags provenance (SourceName 'od-fit-pipeline', deterministic per-pass batch_id). Provider set and per-provider fit config are data-driven (request payload > plugin.getConfig > compiled fallback). Records that cannot be fitted (unsupported frame/time/center, undecodable shells, too few samples, non-converged) are skipped with an honest reason.

timers.description: Periodic OD fit pass over stored OEM records (default every 2h, matching CelesTrak's 2h SupGP regeneration cadence — no value in re-fitting more often than the source ephemerides refresh).

methods.displayName: Fit SupGP/OMM from stored operator ephemeris
methods.description: Reads stored OEM records (storage_query), fits SGP4 mean elements per object with od::fit_sgp4_series, and stores + signs + publishes schema-exact fitted OMM records. Optional JSON config payload overrides the provider set + per-provider fit config.

outputPorts.description: Signed PNM pointer for each fitted OMM published, plus a per-provider fit/skip summary.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Signed PNM pointer for each published fitted-OMM record.
